mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id, username, password_hash, name, email, mobile, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND status = 1
SELECT id FROM sys_department WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 1
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user user_account INNER JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = user_account.id INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE role.code = #{roleCode}

SELECT DISTINCT role.code FROM sys_user user_account INNER JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = user_account.id INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.status = 1 AND role.status = 1 ORDER BY role.code

SELECT DISTINCT permission.code FROM sys_user user_account INNER JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = user_account.id INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id INNER JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.status = 1 AND role.status = 1 AND permission.status = 1 ORDER BY permission.code
SELECT role.id, role.code, role.name FROM sys_user_role user_role INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, create_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{createBy})
